# Stylos

> Stylos is a one-person web design studio in Oxford, founded by classicist and archaeologist Arkadiy Avdokhin. The studio creates websites, research platforms, digital exhibitions, and portfolios for research, heritage, and creative practice.

Canonical website: https://stylos.co/

Contact: office@stylos.co

## Services

- Research websites and public-facing grant platforms
- Digital exhibitions and cultural-heritage interfaces
- 3D visualisation and photogrammetry integration
- Portfolios for artists and independent practitioners
- Frontend design, Firebase-backed content systems, and lightweight back offices

## Selected work

- Aphrodisias 3D Epigraphy: a public platform combining interactive 3D models with scholarly object records
- Festivals & Society: a research website and Firebase database for a Vienna-based project on Roman-era papyri
- Anna Connolly: a proposal-stage portfolio for a performance storyteller
- Russian Lyceum: a parent-facing website system for a private school in Oxford
- Sofia Sharomazova: an artist website centred on painting, motion, and a managed image pipeline
